siteRules: .huiji-css-hook .infobox { width: 300px; background-color: rgb(17, 17, 17); font-size: 14px; float: right; margin-left: 40px; margin-bottom: 30px; color: rgb(238, 238, 238); }
.huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-img { text-align: center; font-size: 1.25em; font-weight: bold; padding: 0px; }
.huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-item-title th, .huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-header th { padding: 8px; background-color: rgb(255, 105, 18); text-align: center; }
.huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-item-title th a, .huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-header th a { color: rgb(34, 34, 34); }
.huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-item-title th a:hover, .huiji-css-hook .infobox .infobox-header th a:hover { color: rgb(0, 0, 0); }

body { margin: 0px; font-size: 14px; font-family: v-sans, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"; line-height: 1.6; text-size-adjust: 100%; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
body { font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.42857; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, .h1, .h2, .h3, .h4, .h5, .h6 { font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; color: inherit; }
.ns-subject:not(.ns-2) #wiki-body h2 { border-bottom-width: medium; border-bottom-style: none; border-bottom-color: currentcolor; padding-bottom: 0.5em; padding-top: 50px; margin: 0px; }
.ns-subject:not(.ns-2) #wiki-body h3 { border-bottom-width: medium; border-bottom-style: none; border-bottom-color: currentcolor; padding-bottom: 0.5em; padding-top: 25px; margin: 0px; }
#wiki-body h2 { border-bottom-width: medium; border-bottom-style: none; border-bottom-color: currentcolor; }

body { background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-family: "PingFang SC", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "WenQuanYi Micro Hei", "Heiti SC", sans-serif; overflow: hidden auto; }
#wiki-body { font-family: "PingFang SC", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "WenQuanYi Micro Hei", "Heiti SC", sans-serif; }
